questions.q: A sensor component puts this in its HEARTBEAT autopilot field:
questions.explain: It is not an autopilot; otherwise the GCS may mistake it for a vehicle.

questions.q: The units of current_distance in DISTANCE_SENSOR:
ArduPilot accepts DISTANCE_SENSOR as a downward rangefinder with:
questions.explain: 10 is MAVLink, 25 is Down; the orientation in the message must match.

questions.q: What should a component do when it loses measurements?
options: Stop sending, or flag the data
Keep sending the last value at the same rate
questions.explain: The autopilot detects the timeout and disables the source.

questions.q: Quickly showing your own number in the GCS and the log without a dialect of your own:
questions.explain: The GCS displays the value, and ArduPilot logs it as NVAL.

questions.q: MAVLink frames from an ESP32 are sometimes broken. The likely cause:
options: Several tasks write to the UART
Too frequent a heartbeat clogs the buffer
questions.explain: You need a single sender task or a mutex on the UART.

questions.q: Which test level proves the autopilot uses the component's data?
options: A test against a fake vehicle
questions.explain: Only it checks that the parameters and the message agree.
